name: Pulley Steak
hook: Lower the sizzling ribeye out the 4th floor window without dropping it
tagline: A greasy cast-iron skillet swings precariously down a rickety clothesline rig across busy Manhattan traffic. Cash out in time to drop the steak cleanly into a hungry hipster's tote bag. Crash and the clothesline snaps, bombarding a police cruiser with hot garlic butter.
